{"task": {"id": "I_kwDONElfw88AAAABW_ZlsQ", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BlV6PzhAi13I", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BlV6P", "number": 55, "title": "Audit and correct PMX IK solver angle limits and MMD compatibility", "body": "## Problem

`CCDIKSolver` is derived from Three.js's generic CCD implementation and performs a simple Euler-component clamp for PMX IK link limits. PMX IK constraints and MMD-style constrained chains require more care than generic unconstrained CCD. A source audit against independent MMD runtimes (notably [babylon-mmd's IkSolver](https://github.com/noname0310/babylon-mmd/blob/main/src/Runtime/ikSolver.ts) and [Saba's MMDIkSolver](https://github.com/benikabocha/saba/blob/master/src/Saba/Model/MMD/MMDIkSolver.cpp)) identifies compatibility risks around single-axis joints, rotation order/angle wrapping, and singular cases. These implementation differences are **not by themselves proof of incorrect behavior**; verify with independent numerical expectations before changing the solver.

Specific code to investigate:

- [`CCDIKSolver.updateOne()`](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/src/animation/CCDIKSolver.ts): applies CCD rotation then clamps `link.rotation` independently using `rotationMin`/`rotationMax`; the code contains a TODO to revisit the limitation specification. Cross products become degenerate for antiparallel directions.
- [`MMDLoader.ts`](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/src/loaders/MMDLoader.ts): PMX left-/right-handed IK limit conversion writes into `lowerLimitationAngle`/`upperLimitationAngle` arrays belonging to parsed source metadata, so repeatedly building a mesh from the *same parsed PMX data* can apply the conversion more than once.
- [`MMDAnimationHelper.ts`](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/src/animation/MMDAnimationHelper.ts): PMX phase/class order, IK/grants and physics-driven link optimization must remain valid.

## Expected outcome

Audit and **correct demonstrated PMX IK solver/limit defects**, prioritizing constrained knees/elbows and other single-axis or multi-axis limited chains. Preserve current ordinary CCD, PMD compatibility and PMX pre-/post-physics orchestration.

Ground the selected algorithm in the PMX format definition and at least two independent MMD runtimes such as Saba and babylon-mmd, explicitly separating file-format semantics from MMD runtime compatibility choices. **Do not blindly transplant another engine's algorithm** or claim byte-for-byte MikuMikuDance equivalence without evidence.

### Pre-merge acceptance criteria — all mandatory and verifiable before merge

- [ ] Document a concise comparison of PMX IK link parameters (iterations, per-step angle, per-link min/max), current `CCDIKSolver`, and at least two independent MMD implementations, including how rotation order, cumulative IK vs authored rotation, and fixed/single-axis links should behave. Identify concrete reproduced incorrect cases, not just structural differences in code.
- [ ] Add deterministic fixture-based regression tests **before/alongside changes** demonstrating an actual failure in IK reachability, link constraint satisfaction, or continuity. Cover unconstrained CCD, X/Y/Z-only links (including knee-like hinges), multi-axis limits, nonzero authored rotation, near ±π boundaries, and reachable/degenerate target geometries. Evaluate both effector-target error and allowed bone-rotation ranges; do not assert every unreachable target must be reached.
- [ ] Correct the demonstrated constrained IK handling with the smallest coherent change (e.g., axis-aware solving/appropriate rotation decomposition or representation, where justified). Respect each link's allowed range, MMD-style per-iteration angle limits and transformation ordering. Test that repeated updates do not introduce instability, NaNs, unintended drift or discontinuous flips.
- [ ] Handle zero-length, parallel and antiparallel effector/target directions deterministically. For the antiparallel case, rotate about a permitted stable axis **when a valid solution exists**; never force an invalid rotation for a locked/unreachable link. Invalid link indices, nonfinite constraints/poses, invalid ranges and excessive iterations must fail safely without poisoning unrelated bones.
- [ ] Make PMX IK-limit coordinate conversion **non-mutating** with respect to parsed `mmd-parser` data; verify identical conversion/results from two mesh builds using the same parsed PMX data, and valid min/max bounds after handedness conversion. Keep any PMD-specific knee heuristic compatible unless an independent reproducer justifies changing it.
- [ ] Preserve PMX pre-/post-physics scheduling, transformation classes, IK/grant composition, physics-driven link disabling, reset/seek/loop, and Type 0/1/2 body authority. Ensure both sync and Worker physics continue to use the same main-thread IK behavior; do not change Bullet stepping, Worker transport, or Type-2 physics semantics.
- [ ] Add executable comparisons/analytical oracles that establish correctness without private third-party models. Compare with reference-runtime outputs **where reproducible** and record coordinate-system, pose, tolerance, and intentional compatibility-policy differences. Do not simply update assertions to match newly produced output.
- [ ] Run and report `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run test:browser` (where applicable), `npm run build`, and `git diff --check`. All required verification must run on the PR/branch using available dependencies and synthetic or repository-provided fixtures; no private-model download, live published demo check, hardware inspection, or maintainer approval is a prerequisite.

### Required post-merge verification

**None.** No post-merge-only task or checkbox is a prerequisite for closing this issue or merging its PR.

**Optional maintainer follow-up (not an acceptance criterion, not a merge blocker):** After merge, the maintainer may visually inspect knees, elbows, feet, and post-physics IK on legitimate real PMX models in the local or published examples, and file a separate follow-up if differences remain. Do not claim that this manual check passed before it occurs.

## Context

- [`src/animation/CCDIKSolver.ts`](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/src/animation/CCDIKSolver.ts)
- [`src/loaders/MMDLoader.ts`](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/src/loaders/MMDLoader.ts)
- [`src/animation/MMDAnimationHelper.ts`](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/src/animation/MMDAnimationHelper.ts)
- Relevant existing tests: `tests/runtime.test.ts`, `tests/physics-layers.test.ts`, `tests/grant.test.ts` and browser tests.
- Independent implementations: [babylon-mmd](https://github.com/noname0310/babylon-mmd/blob/main/src/Runtime/ikSolver.ts), [Saba](https://github.com/benikabocha/saba/blob/master/src/Saba/Model/MMD/MMDIkSolver.cpp), and [Three.js's historical CCDIKSolver](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/r171/examples/jsm/animation/CCDIKSolver.js).
- Related completed work: #39 (PMX pose and physics phase order), #53 (Type-2 body authority), #47 (Worker Physics). Preserve those behaviors.

**Scope:** IK calculation and IK-limit import/validation, necessary targeted tests and documentation only.
